items.say: Sir Clank the knight tidied up the playroom. He put a potion on the shelf and a key in the toy box. Under the bed, he found a chest and a sword, both covered in dust. Then he lay down for a rest. Which one of these was not in the story?

Zazz the wizard packed a bag for a trip to the beach. He put in a boot and a map. He wanted a bell and a gem too, but there was no more room. At the last minute, he squeezed in a coin. Tap everything Zazz packed.

There was a big party at the castle yesterday. Dash the fox wanted to come, but she had to work. Pounce the cat arrived late and stayed to the end. Zazz the wizard forgot all about it and stayed home. Sir Clank the knight was sick in bed and could not come. Puff the dragon brought a huge cake. Tap everyone who was at the party.

Dash the fox moved to a new home across the river. She loaded a bell and a book onto the cart. There was no room for her egg or her flag, so they stayed behind. She took a map as well. In the rush, she forgot all about her gem. Tap everything Dash left behind.

Zip the robot had a stall at the market. By lunch time, he had sold a shield and a bell. A farmer bought a sword. At the end of the day, only a key was left on the table. Which one of these was not in the story?

Sir Clank the knight packed a bag for a trip to the beach. He picked up a shield, but then he put it down again. So he put in a key and a sword. He also packed a star and a potion. He looked at a ring, but he left it on the bed. Tap everything Sir Clank packed.

There was a big party at the castle yesterday. Sir Clank the knight wanted to come, but he had to work. Puff the dragon came early and helped with the food. Hoot the owl brought a huge cake. Pounce the cat was sick in bed and could not come. Zip the robot played music for everyone. Tap everyone who was at the party.

Puff the dragon moved to a new home across the river. In the rush, he forgot all about his bell. He loaded a coin, a rocket, and a mushroom onto the cart. There was no room for his map or his book, so they stayed behind. Tap everything Puff left behind.

Boo the ghost had a very silly dream. In the dream, a key was chasing a mushroom around the castle. A coin was singing a song, and a chest was dancing on the table. Then he woke up. Which one of these was not in the dream?
Hoot the owl packed a bag for a camping trip. First, she packed a heart. She wanted a key and a crown as well, but they would not fit. Then she added a flag and a star. Tap everything Hoot packed.

There was a big party at the castle yesterday. Puff the dragon played music for everyone. Hoot the owl danced for hours and hours. Zazz the wizard brought a huge cake. Dash the fox forgot all about it and stayed home. Sir Clank the knight came early and helped with the food. Tap everyone who was at the party.

Zip the robot moved to a new home across the river. He loaded a ring onto the cart. There was no room for his heart, so it stayed behind. In the rush, he forgot all about his rocket and his gem. He did take a mushroom and a drum. Tap everything Zip left behind.

Puff the dragon climbed up into the dusty attic. Behind the door, he saw a chest. On the floor lay a coin and a map. Hanging from the roof was a drum. He sneezed three times and climbed back down. Which one of these was not in the attic?

Zazz the wizard packed a bag for a night at the castle. He put in a book and a crown. He wanted a mushroom and a gem too, but there was no more room. At the last minute, he squeezed in a key and a drum. Tap everything Zazz packed.

There was a big party at the castle yesterday. Sir Clank the knight brought a huge cake. Pounce the cat played music for everyone. Boo the ghost got lost and never got there. Zip the robot wanted to come, but he had to work. Puff the dragon was sick in bed and could not come. Tap everyone who was at the party.

Zazz the wizard moved to a new home across the river. He loaded a gem and a bell onto the cart. There was no room for his torch or his potion, so they stayed behind. He took a boot as well. In the rush, he forgot all about his star. Tap everything Zazz left behind.

Zip the robot tidied up the playroom. He put a sword on the shelf and a potion in the toy box. Under the bed, he found a torch and a crown, both covered in dust. Then he lay down for a rest. Which one of these was not in the story?

Dash the fox packed a bag for a trip to the beach. She picked up a gem, but then she put it down again. So she put in a heart and a key. She also packed a boot. She looked at a shield, but she left it on the bed. Tap everything Dash packed.
